# Baseline of leaf modules that currently lack a README.md (the doc-currency ratchet).
#
# The check-module-readmes.sh gate fails on any NEW module without a README, but tolerates the
# entries listed here so the pre-existing debt doesn't block unrelated PRs. The documentation
# correction pass should ADD the missing README and DELETE its line here — the list only shrinks.
#
# One module path per line (relative to repo root), '#' comments and blank lines ignored.
